summary: Buffer size lookup: maps the selector a1 to a fixed buffer size through a switch dispatched via the jump table at 0x00464ECC. a1 == 1 yields 2975, a1 == 2 yields 7200, a1 == 3 yields 28800, a1 == 4 yields 625000, and any other value yields the default 1487. Called by ConditionalDelegateBasedOnCounter (00464EE0) and ShortComputation_5430 (00465430) to size a buffer.

operations.description: Switch on the selector a1, dispatching through the jump table global at 0x00464ECC.
Invoked by ConditionalDelegateBasedOnCounter (00464EE0) and ShortComputation_5430 (00465430) to obtain a buffer size for a given selector.

unresolved: The semantic meaning of the selector a1 and which buffers the returned sizes describe are not determinable from this function alone.
The jump table global at 0x00464ECC is read for dispatch but its full layout is outside this function.
